WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT notice_ref, bout_id, desk_minutes, ABS(posted_pts - witness_pts) AS discrepancy
  FROM discrepancy_notices
  WHERE witness_pts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT a.notice_ref AS first_ref, b.notice_ref AS second_ref,
       a.discrepancy + b.discrepancy AS points_at_issue,
       a.desk_minutes + b.desk_minutes AS total_minutes
FROM eligible AS a
JOIN eligible AS b ON a.notice_ref COLLATE BINARY < b.notice_ref AND a.bout_id <> b.bout_id
WHERE a.desk_minutes + b.desk_minutes <= 10
ORDER BY points_at_issue DESC, total_minutes ASC, first_ref COLLATE BINARY ASC, second_ref COLLATE BINARY ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH limits AS (
  SELECT m.meal_id, m.tip_cents, p.source_id,
         (m.food_cents + CASE p.base_kind WHEN 'gross' THEN m.tax_cents ELSE 0 END) * p.cap_bp / 10000 AS max_tip_cents
  FROM meal_claim AS m
  JOIN policy_notice AS p ON p.source_id = (
    SELECT n.source_id
    FROM policy_notice AS n
    WHERE n.program_code = m.program_code AND n.effective_day <= m.service_day
    ORDER BY n.effective_day DESC
    LIMIT 1
  )
)
SELECT meal_id, tip_cents - max_tip_cents AS reduction_cents, source_id
FROM limits
WHERE tip_cents > max_tip_cents
ORDER BY meal_id ASC
submissions.decision-apply-one-pass-folder-moves:
SELECT COALESCE((
  SELECT m.next_dir || substr(f.prior_path, length(m.prior_dir) + 1)
  FROM folder_move AS m
  WHERE instr(f.prior_path, m.prior_dir || '/') = 1
  ORDER BY length(m.prior_dir) DESC
  LIMIT 1
), f.prior_path) AS final_path, f.asset_tag
FROM asset_file AS f
ORDER BY final_path COLLATE BINARY ASC

WITH available AS (
  SELECT i.account_code, i.invoice_code, i.due_day, i.open_cents,
         r.payment_cents - COALESCE(SUM(i.open_cents) OVER (
           PARTITION BY i.account_code
           ORDER BY i.due_day, i.invoice_code COLLATE BINARY
           ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
         ), 0) AS cash_left
  FROM open_invoice AS i
  JOIN remittance_batch AS r ON r.account_code = i.account_code
  WHERE i.hold_note IS NULL AND i.open_cents > 0
), applied AS (
  SELECT account_code, invoice_code, due_day, open_cents, MIN(open_cents, cash_left) AS applied_cents
  FROM available
  WHERE cash_left > 0
)
SELECT account_code, invoice_code, applied_cents, open_cents - applied_cents AS remaining_open_cents
FROM applied
ORDER BY account_code COLLATE BINARY ASC, due_day ASC, invoice_code COLLATE BINARY ASC
